description: Search the official Adobe Commerce (Magento Open Source) developer documentation bundled offline: PHP extensions, frontend core, Web APIs and operations. Use it first for any "how do I" question about modules, plugins, DI, events, declarative schema, layouts, caching, indexers, queues or configuration. Returns excerpts with title, public URL and source path; follow up with read-doc.

area.description: Restrict to one doc set: php (PHP extensions), frontend (themes, layouts, UI components, JS), webapi (REST and GraphQL guides), operations (configuration, CLI, installation, performance)

query.description: Keywords to look for in the official Adobe Commerce docs (e.g. "plugin around method", "declarative schema foreign key", "message queue consumer", "full page cache private content")

name: search-docs
title: Search Adobe Commerce docs
